findings.name: No authentication on remote MCP server
findings.evidence:
https://mcp.squareup.com/sse -> HTTP 401
{"error":"invalid_token","error_description":"Missing or invalid access token"}
findings.spec_reference: Transports §Security: servers SHOULD authenticate all connections. A protected server MUST answer 401 when authorization is required.

findings.name: Cleartext HTTP transport (no TLS)
findings.spec_reference: OAuth 2.1 §1.5 / MCP Authorization: auth-bearing traffic MUST use HTTPS (loopback exempt).

findings.name: 401 without RFC 9728 WWW-Authenticate pointer
findings.evidence: WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="OAuth", resource_metadata="https://mcp.squareup.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/sse", error="invalid_token", error_description="Missing or invalid access token"
findings.spec_reference: MCP Authorization 2025-06-18: on 401 the server MUST return WWW-Authenticate indicating the protected-resource-metadata URL (RFC 9728 §5.1).

findings.name: Missing OAuth Protected Resource Metadata (RFC 9728)
findings.spec_reference: MCP Authorization 2025-06-18: servers MUST expose RFC 9728 metadata at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource including authorization_servers.

findings.name: Session identifier carried in URL/query string
findings.evidence:
https://mcp.squareup.com/sse -> HTTP 401
{"error":"invalid_token","error_description":"Missing or invalid access token"}
findings.spec_reference: OAuth 2.1 §5: tokens MUST NOT appear in URI query. MCP Streamable HTTP moved the session to the Mcp-Session-Id header.
findings.notes: No header session id and no URL-borne session id observed.
